title: P-Video 2 Pro
description: Pruna AI P-Video 2 Pro — text-to-video, and image-to-video from a first frame, a last frame, or both. 480p or 768p, any length from 5 to 15 seconds, 24 fps, with generated audio. Three generation modes set the price with the resolution: `cost` (cheapest, and the fastest), `speed` (the default) and `quality` (the most detailed and the slowest). Billed per second of output; see `mode_pricing` in GET /v1/models or POST /v1/cost.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for text-to-video. With a frame image the image sets the shape and this is ignored.

end_image.description: Optional last frame. With `image` the video moves between the two frames; on its own the video ends on it. Same input forms as `image`.

image.description: Optional first frame for image-to-video; the video starts from it and follows its framing. Provide a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads.

length_seconds.description: Video length in seconds, any whole number from 5 to 15.

mode.description: Generation mode, which sets the price together with `resolution`: `cost` is the cheapest and also the fastest (about 20 s for 5 s of video), `speed` is the default (about 70 s), `quality` is the most detailed and the slowest (about 85 s). Credits per second: see `mode_pricing` in GET /v1/models.

prompt.description: Text description of the video, including any sound you want to hear.

resolution.description: Output resolution: 480p (832x480 at 16:9) or 768p (1344x768 at 16:9). Sets the price together with `mode`.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible generation. Omit for random.
